name: smoke
description: Starter gold set covering all 7 memory buckets and the main retrieval patterns. Twelve questions — enough to verify the eval harness works end-to-end. Replace with your own >=50-question set per project before running CI gates.

questions.question: Why did we choose Postgres over Pinecone for vector search?
questions.notes: Single-decision lookup. Should retrieve the canonical decision memory.

questions.question: What alternatives did we consider for vector search and why did we reject them?
questions.notes: Tests that decision memories' rejected-alternatives text is searchable, not just the chosen path.

questions.question: What did the pricing A/B test on the landing page reveal?
questions.notes: Observation lookup. Recent - should rank high on recency.

questions.question: What logging fields should every 5xx error path capture?
questions.notes: Tests learning-bucket retrieval. Question phrased in present-tense to verify search isn't over-anchored on past-tense recall verbs.

questions.question: What needs to happen before we onboard the Mumbai design partner?
questions.notes: Open todo lookup. Should NOT return completed todos (status filter).

questions.question: Have we decided whether to ship a self-host installer in v1?
questions.notes: Question-bucket retrieval. Expected answer: 'no, still unresolved' - tests that question memories are returned with their resolution status.

questions.question: Who is our primary LLM vendor and what's their privacy posture?
questions.notes: Entity lookup. Tests entity-bucket retrieval and that compliance metadata surfaces.

questions.question: Where are we on the DPDP / GDPR erasure cascade work?
questions.notes: Summary-bucket retrieval. These are keeper-generated; the harness verifies that summaries don't get over-decayed by their lower individual confidence.

questions.question: What's the YC application strategy and what's blocking it?
questions.notes: Multi-memory query. Tests that the bundle returns both the decision (strategy) and the gating todo (blocker), not just one.

questions.question: What were the most important things decided this week?
questions.notes: Recency + bucket-filter query. 'this week' is relative - the harness can either pin the eval date or treat it as a heuristic.

questions.question: What did Bob say in #random yesterday?
questions.notes: Negative test. Chat banter shouldn't be in the vault. Expected: empty citation set. F1 here only counts precision (no false retrievals).

questions.question: What's our quarterly revenue?
questions.notes: Negative test. We don't ingest financial systems. Expected: empty citation set. Validates that the bundle doesn't hallucinate.
